title: Independent Coupling Head-Accuracy Objective and Versioned Numerical Policy Template Qualification
intended_application_class: General-purpose direct iterative SWAP-MODFLOW coupling for water-table and soil-water applications in which interface head and exchange flux affect coupled predictions. This registration does not assume a specific spatial resolution, management decision, observation network, target fixture, or calibrated MODFLOW model.

accuracy_objective_hierarchy.name: application_quantity_of_interest
accuracy_objective_hierarchy.meaning: The prediction or decision whose acceptable error must ultimately be protected, for example groundwater level, root-zone response, drainage, capillary rise, or another application-defined quantity.

accuracy_objective_hierarchy.name: application_head_accuracy_requirement
accuracy_objective_hierarchy.meaning: A finite positive head-accuracy requirement justified by the intended application, observational resolution, decision threshold, benchmark, or independently qualified reference comparison.

accuracy_objective_hierarchy.name: physical_and_representation_uncertainty
accuracy_objective_hierarchy.meaning: Conceptual-model, parameter, observation, spatial-discretization and other physical/model-representation uncertainties. These contextualize H_app but are not coupling tolerances and cannot by themselves be used to hide numerical error.

accuracy_objective_hierarchy.name: coupling_error_allocation
accuracy_objective_hierarchy.meaning: The portion of the independently specified application accuracy requirement allocated to coupling and component numerical error. Allocation requires an explicit rationale and may be application/version specific.

accuracy_objective_hierarchy.name: richards_temporal_head_budget
accuracy_objective_hierarchy.meaning: The finite positive Richards temporal head-accuracy budget used by the qualified certificate C_h = B_inf / H_budget. It is not an observed error and is not selected from B_inf.

accuracy_objective_hierarchy.name: component_solver_convergence_criteria
accuracy_objective_hierarchy.meaning: Richards nonlinear/linear convergence settings and MODFLOW IMS closure criteria. These are solver controls, not application accuracy requirements.

accuracy_objective_hierarchy.name: diagnostic_indicators
accuracy_objective_hierarchy.meaning: Observed temporal indicators such as B_inf and coupling/interface residual diagnostics. They assess a frozen policy but cannot define the policy by target fitting.

explicit_accuracy_objective: Keep the Richards temporal-integration contribution sufficiently below an independently stated application/coupling head-accuracy allowance that it does not consume an unjustified share of the application error budget, while preserving exact mass accounting and the explicit SWAP-MODFLOW interface contract. No absolute centimetre value is preregistered here because the external application requirement has not yet been identified.

constraints: H_app must have traceable provenance independent of F-GC02 and F-GC04 indicator magnitudes
A_temporal must be in (0,1] and justified independently as an error-allocation policy rather than chosen to pass a target fixture
H_budget must be finite and positive
the policy version must identify application scope and provenance
mass conservation is not relaxed by any head-accuracy allocation
interface-head residual tolerance remains a separate coupling convergence control unless an independent derivation explicitly relates it to H_cpl

validation_matrix: MODFLOW solver closure semantics versus actual head accuracy
spatial and temporal discretization error versus coupling/component temporal error
coupling interface residual semantics versus temporal indicator semantics
application sensitivity of groundwater level and soil-water process predictions
evidence for or against a transferable absolute centimetre-scale application objective
traceability of any H_app and A_temporal to independent application evidence
target-leakage audit before any F-GC02 rerun
reject_criteria: the only numeric basis is the F-GC02 target result
the only numeric basis is the F-GC04 B_inf distribution
a MODFLOW or Richards solver tolerance is re-labelled as application head accuracy
a coupling head residual is re-labelled as Richards temporal error without derivation
physical/model uncertainty is used as permission for arbitrary numerical error
the proposed absolute head objective is not transferable across the stated application class
the error-allocation fraction is selected after viewing target-fixture pass/fail behavior
mass conservation or interface flux conservation is relaxed

independent_source_axes.source: USGS MODFLOW 6 Groundwater Flow Model documentation
independent_source_axes.finding_to_test: MODFLOW head-change closure is a convergence criterion and does not itself guarantee equal head-solution accuracy.

independent_source_axes.source: USGS groundwater-model limitation and uncertainty literature
independent_source_axes.finding_to_test: Spatial discretization, time discretization, parameter structure, observations and conceptualization are distinct contributors to prediction uncertainty.

independent_source_axes.source: Dagès, Paniconi and Sulis (2012); Fiorentini, Orlandini and Paniconi (2015)
independent_source_axes.finding_to_test: Coupling error is scheme- and time-resolution-dependent and must be diagnosed separately from component solver tolerances and physical uncertainty.

hard_nonclaims: no numeric H_budget candidate has been evaluated
